## What

- Add scoped Google Python Style Guide instructions for MFSDP v2 implementation code and its unit tests, with the repository's 100-character line-length override.
- Add `CLAUDE.md` symlinks to the scoped instructions so Claude Code uses the same guidance.
- Convert MFSDP v2-package relative imports to absolute `megatron_fsdp` imports.
- Add the missing initializer docstring for `Flat`.
- Wrap the two non-exempt overlong test lines; the remaining long line is a URL comment, which Google permits.

## Validation

- `isort --check-only megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/experimental`
- `black --check megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/experimental`
- `ruff check megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/experimental`
- `ruff check --select D megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/experimental`
- `PYTHONPATH=megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src python -c 'import megatron_fsdp.experimental'`
- `python -m compileall -q megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/experimental`
- `isort --check-only tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_expert_parallel.py tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_symmetric_memory.py`
- `black --check tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_expert_parallel.py tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_symmetric_memory.py`
- `ruff check tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_expert_parallel.py tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/test_symmetric_memory.py`

@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+Use https://google.github.io/styleguide/pyguide.html as the style guide.
+
+Use a maximum line length of 100 characters, overriding the Google style guide.
+
+Use relative imports for intra-package imports. This package is distributed both as
+``megatron_fsdp`` and as part of ``megatron.core``, so no single absolute import path works
+in both distributions.

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+AGENTS.md
\ No newline at end of file
